title: Microsoft.Testing.Platform extension manifest
description: Declares extensions that Microsoft.Testing.Platform loads dynamically at start-up. The file name must end with '.testingplatformextensions.json' and the file must sit next to the test application. Loading is off by default and must be enabled per run with the '--enable-dynamic-extensions' command line option. Dynamically loaded extensions run with full trust inside the test process: do not use this feature with code or directories you do not trust. See https://github.com/microsoft/testfx/blob/main/docs/RFCs/023-Dynamic-Extension-Loading.md.

$schema.description: The URI of this JSON schema.

extensions.description: The extensions to load, in the order in which their hooks are invoked.

assemblyPath.description: Path to the assembly containing the hook type. A relative path is resolved against the directory of this manifest.

typeFullName.description: Full name of the type declaring the static 'AddExtensions(ITestApplicationBuilder, string[])' hook.

id.description: Stable identifier used to de-duplicate the same extension declared by several manifests. Compared ordinally and case-insensitively. Defaults to the resolved assembly path combined with the type full name. A blank value is treated as omitted at run time, so give it a real value or leave it out.

displayName.description: Human-readable name for the extension. Used in the loaded-extensions report, the diagnostic log, and assembly-level errors. Defaults to the type full name.

enabled.description: Whether the extension is loaded. Set to false to keep the declaration in place without loading it.
